name: Comms API endpoint returns valid JSON

actions.comment: Fetched rather than navigated: /api/* is behind the bearer gate (only /api/health and /api/auth/verify are exempt), and a plain browser navigation cannot send an Authorization header, so navigating to /api/dashboard/comms only ever yielded 401. The token is the one the login step already put in localStorage.
actions.value: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/api/dashboard/comms', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('kernel_auth_token') } }); document.body.innerText = r.ok ? JSON.stringify(await r.json()) : 'api-fail ' + r.status; })(); true;

expect: Raw JSON response with kpis object (total, drafts, sent, failed), byChannel, byStatus, pendingDrafts array, and recentSent array

name: Comms view renders with KPI cards and panels

actions.comment: ViewHeader renders `title` into `.view-title`, and the comms extension page passes title="Comms" (subtitle 'Multi-channel communications'). The old 'Communications' heading is gone.

expect: Comms dashboard view with the 'Comms' header showing total count, KPI cards for Drafts (gold), Sent (green), Failed (red), and Total (teal), plus By Channel and By Status bar charts

name: Create draft via MCP tool

actions.value: (async()=>{var text=await window.__toolCall('kernel_comms_create',{subject:'E2E Test Draft',body:'Testing the comms module end-to-end via MCP HTTP transport.',recipients_to:'e2e-test@example.com'});var m=text.match(/ID: ([a-f0-9-]+)/);window.__testDraftId=m?m[1]:null;window.__showResult(text)})()

expect: Green monospace overlay at the top showing MCP tool response: 'Communication created' with a UUID ID, Channel: email, Status: draft, To: e2e-test@example.com, Subject: E2E Test Draft

name: Created draft appears in Comms dashboard
expect: The Comms dashboard view shows 'E2E Test Draft' in the Pending Drafts section with an email channel badge and e2e-test@example.com recipient

name: Create reply to draft via MCP tool

actions.value: (async()=>{var t1=await window.__toolCall('kernel_comms_create',{subject:'E2E Reply Source',body:'Original message for reply testing. Please review the attached proposal.',recipients_to:'reply-test@example.com'});var m=t1.match(/ID: ([a-f0-9-]+)/);if(!m){window.__showResult('ERROR: Create failed');return}var draftId=m[1];var t2=await window.__toolCall('kernel_comms_reply',{comm_id:draftId,body:'Thanks, I will review it today.',include_quote:true});window.__showResult(['=== ORIGINAL ===',t1,'','=== REPLY ===',t2].join(String.fromCharCode(10)))})()

expect: Green overlay showing two sections: ORIGINAL with the created draft, and REPLY with 'Reply draft created', Subject: Re: E2E Reply Source, To: reply-test@example.com, Status: draft, and the original message quoted in the body

name: Reply includes quoted text and thread info

actions.value: (async()=>{var t1=await window.__toolCall('kernel_comms_create',{subject:'Thread Test',body:'Can we meet tomorrow at 3pm?',recipients_to:'thread@example.com'});var m=t1.match(/ID: ([a-f0-9-]+)/);if(!m){window.__showResult('ERROR');return}var id=m[1];var t2=await window.__toolCall('kernel_comms_reply',{comm_id:id,body:'Sure, 3pm works for me.',include_quote:true});var m2=t2.match(/ID: ([a-f0-9-]+)/);var replyId=m2?m2[1]:'';var t3=await window.__toolCall('kernel_comms_get',{id:replyId});window.__showResult(t3)})()

expect: Green overlay showing the full reply communication details: Subject 'Re: Thread Test', body starting with 'Sure, 3pm works for me.' followed by quoted original '> Can we meet tomorrow at 3pm?', To: thread@example.com

name: Search inbox via MCP tool
expect: Green overlay showing either Gmail search results (numbered list with From, Date, snippet, Gmail ID for each email) or 'No emails found' or an error message if Gmail is not configured. Any of these responses indicates the tool is working.
